title: Money & Budgets
headline: Know where every rupee is going.
subhead: Money moves along one traceable path — from the client's payment to the last bill on site.
description: Every site shows spend against budget, monthly burn rate and an on-track, warning or over-budget status. See, site by site, what you've spent against what each client has paid.

steps.text: You verify the payment before it counts into funds.

steps.text: The live balance you actually have in hand.

steps.text: Cash you assign; each verified bill reduces it.

steps.title: Site Expenses
steps.text: Purchases, wages, contractors and extras post directly to the site.
